csr.description: Base64-encoded PKCS#10 DER certificate signing request.

requestedDuration.description: Requested cert lifetime as a Go duration string accepted by time.ParseDuration, e.g. "720h", "1h30m", "90m", "1.5h". Pattern admits compound/fractional Go durations but rejects free-form text; clamped to the Signer's max-TTL SignConstraints (PR-5).

usages.description: Requested X.509 key/extended-key usages (cert-manager spelling). Supported values: "signing" or "digital signature", "key encipherment", "client auth", "server auth". Any other value is rejected with 422 by the enrollment front-end (deviceidentity mapUsages); the supported set is intentionally narrower than the full cert-manager vocabulary. An empty list defaults to digital signature + client auth (device-certificate baseline). ref: cert-manager KeyUsage; RFC 5280 §4.2.1.3.
